question: How does the practitioner utter mantras and mudras during this advanced state?
premises: The practitioner engages all mantras and mudras
His utterance becomes stammering or confused
This occurs as a marked effect of the state
inference: In this state he utters the entire group of mantras and mudras in a stammering manner.
uncertainties: The exact sense of durdurapluta is rare and interpretive
plain_english: He indeed utters the entire group of mantras and mudras in a stammering way.
